title: A stock is not its flow
hook: A smaller drain changes the accumulated stock. How much after three updates?

knows: Addition and subtraction of whole units.
doesNotKnow: A stock accumulates the net difference between fixed inflows and outflows.

misconception: A one-unit flow change makes only a one-unit difference in the final stock.
objective: Calculate cumulative stock change and distinguish a stored quantity from its per-step flows.

claims.text: Stocks change through accumulated inflows and outflows.
